column2: The ultimatum was rejected, but the orders issued in its wake did not establish a campaign under the republic's command. The raad must now confirm the instructions to its commandants. The kingdom remains the intended opponent, and no Swazi administration can declare this campaign against itself. Our officers will deliver the final notice, end any dependency relationship that prevents hostilities, and establish the conquest demand in the republic's name. The government will bear the diplomatic consequences of that decision.
Confirm the orders and bring the commandants before the raad.
The Cape Conference: Executing the Peace

The conference has settled the imperial dispute in favour of the republic. Its articles surrender the British Cape districts, Natal and Zululand, together with Mabhudu, to republican administration. Swaziland and Basutoland retain their local governments under the republic's protection. Commissioners must now deliver the posts, registers and public property covered by the agreement. An incomplete handover cannot overturn the terms already accepted by the belligerents. The loss of the Cape will shake the imperial government, while the Volksraad faces the task of governing the territories obtained through victory.
Execute the conference articles and establish republican administration.
